answer: Locks are entered in juniper, expire in oasis, and pearl lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 195 aliases thus needs 65 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3764 identities would post 3644 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
